reviewNote: Familiarity revision 3 replaces 111 specialist events and simplifies technical wording. Retained subjects keep their previous 66-day calendar positions; new subjects fill retired slots. Earlier full snapshots, accepted ranges, scores and all original Prior files are preserved. Familiarity anchors are editorial judgements, not player data. Every event has a citation; source checks and their limits are recorded separately.

editorialRevision.reason: Player feedback: recognisable subjects, plain wording and at least two everyday/famous editorial anchors per Daily.

events.title: Pringles first go on sale in the US
events.fact: The potato-based snack first reaches US customers before its later international expansion.

events.title: Amazon opens its online bookstore
events.fact: The website begins selling books to the public; the company was founded the year before.

events.title: The first iPad goes on sale
events.fact: Apple's original tablet reaches US customers in April.

events.title: An earthquake and tsunami trigger the Fukushima nuclear disaster
events.fact: The earthquake and tsunami in Japan lead to the nuclear accident at Fukushima Daiichi.

events.title: Adele releases the album 21
events.fact: The album includes Rolling in the Deep and Someone Like You.

events.title: Stranger Things first appears on Netflix
events.fact: The first season of the science-fiction television series is released.

events.title: The first Starbucks opens
events.fact: Three founders open Starbucks in Seattle, initially selling coffee beans, tea and spices.

events.title: Oreo biscuits first go on sale
events.fact: The sandwich biscuits are introduced by the National Biscuit Company in the United States.

events.title: Disney's animated The Lion King reaches US cinemas
events.fact: The original animated film introduces Simba; this is not the later photorealistic remake.

events.title: The first Hunger Games film reaches cinemas
events.fact: Jennifer Lawrence plays Katniss in the first film adaptation of the book series.

events.title: Queen releases Bohemian Rhapsody
events.fact: The song is released as a single and appears on A Night at the Opera.

events.title: Play-Doh goes on sale as a modelling toy
events.fact: A former wallpaper-cleaning compound is marketed as a children's modelling toy.

events.title: Ratatouille reaches US cinemas
events.fact: Pixar's film follows Remy, a rat who wants to cook in Paris.

events.title: James Cameron's Avatar reaches cinemas
events.fact: The original film introduces the world of Pandora and the Na'vi; it is not the animated television series.

events.title: The Boeing 747 jumbo jet makes its first flight
events.fact: The original 747 flies for the first time in February; commercial passenger service begins the following year.

events.title: Usain Bolt runs 100 metres in a world-record 9.58 seconds
events.fact: Bolt sets the record at the World Championships in Berlin, rather than at an Olympic Games.

events.title: The first Winter Olympic Games take place
events.fact: Chamonix hosts the event later recognised as the first Winter Olympics.

events.title: The original Matrix film reaches cinemas
events.fact: Keanu Reeves stars as Neo in the first film, before the sequels.

events.title: Disney's original Mary Poppins reaches cinemas
events.fact: Julie Andrews plays the magical nanny in the original film.

events.title: Kodak builds an experimental digital camera
events.fact: Steven Sasson's prototype records digital images onto a cassette tape; it is a prototype, not a retail launch.

events.title: The first Pizza Hut opens
events.fact: The Carney brothers open their first pizza restaurant in Wichita, Kansas.

events.title: The Spice Girls release Wannabe
events.fact: The group's debut single launches their recording career.

events.title: Connect Four first goes on sale
events.fact: Milton Bradley introduces the familiar four-in-a-row game.

events.title: The Indian Ocean earthquake and tsunami strike
events.fact: An earthquake off Sumatra triggers a devastating tsunami across the Indian Ocean.

events.title: A Minecraft Movie reaches cinemas
events.fact: The live-action film starring Jack Black and Jason Momoa is released, long after the game first appeared.

events.title: Scientists identify the virus that causes AIDS
events.fact: Researchers isolate the virus later known as HIV; this is distinct from the earlier recognition of AIDS as a syndrome.

events.title: Psy releases Gangnam Style
events.fact: The South Korean song and its music video become an international hit.

events.title: Pixar's Cars reaches US cinemas
events.fact: Lightning McQueen appears in the original Cars film.

events.title: The film Grease reaches cinemas
events.fact: John Travolta and Olivia Newton-John star in the musical film.

events.title: WhatsApp launches
events.fact: The messaging service begins, before Facebook later buys it.

events.title: Apple's original Macintosh goes on sale
events.fact: The first Macintosh computer launches in January.

events.title: The Channel Tunnel between Britain and France officially opens
events.fact: The undersea rail tunnel is formally opened by Queen Elizabeth II and President François Mitterrand.

events.title: SpongeBob SquarePants first airs on US television
events.fact: Nickelodeon previews the series in May before its regular run begins in July of the same year.

events.title: Polaroid's first instant camera goes on sale
events.fact: The Model 95 reaches customers in the United States, letting them develop a photograph shortly after taking it.

events.title: Construction of the International Space Station begins in orbit
events.fact: The first station module launches in November, followed by the first assembly mission.

events.title: The Second World War ends
events.fact: Japan's surrender brings the war to an end in this year; the European fighting had ended earlier that year.

events.title: Game of Thrones first airs on television
events.fact: The HBO television series begins, years after the first novel was published.

events.title: ABBA wins Eurovision with Waterloo
events.fact: The Swedish group wins the Eurovision Song Contest in Brighton.

events.title: The film The Sound of Music reaches cinemas
events.fact: Julie Andrews plays Maria in the film adaptation of the stage musical.

events.title: Apple's original AirPods go on sale
events.fact: The first wireless AirPods earbuds reach customers in December.

events.title: King Charles III is crowned
events.fact: Charles and Camilla are crowned at Westminster Abbey; his reign began the previous year.

events.title: Simone Biles wins her first Olympic all-around title
events.fact: Biles wins the women's individual all-around gymnastics title in Rio de Janeiro.

events.title: Nutella first goes on sale
events.fact: Ferrero introduces the spread under the Nutella name, following earlier chocolate-and-hazelnut products.

events.title: Concorde makes its first flight
events.fact: The supersonic passenger aircraft makes its first test flight in France; passenger services begin later.

events.title: Marvel's The Avengers reaches cinemas
events.fact: Iron Man, Captain America, Thor and other heroes join forces in the Marvel film.

events.title: The Rosetta Stone is discovered in Egypt
events.fact: The stone is found during Napoleon's Egyptian campaign, long after its ancient inscription was made.

events.title: London's Big Ben begins chiming at the Palace of Westminster
events.fact: The current great bell first sounds in July; the tower's clock had started running earlier that year.

events.title: Snapchat first launches
events.fact: The app initially appears as Picaboo before adopting the Snapchat name later that year.

events.title: The Burj Khalifa opens in Dubai
events.fact: The skyscraper officially opens as the world's tallest building.

events.title: The sitcom Friends first airs
events.fact: The original US television series begins on NBC.

events.title: WALL-E reaches US cinemas
events.fact: Pixar releases its film about a small waste-collecting robot.

events.title: Barack Obama becomes US president
events.fact: Obama is inaugurated as the forty-fourth president of the United States.

events.title: The first Paralympic Games take place
events.fact: Rome hosts the event recognised as the first Summer Paralympic Games, following earlier Stoke Mandeville competitions.

events.title: GPS becomes fully operational
events.fact: The US satellite navigation system reaches full operational capability, following years of development and launches.

events.title: The Incredibles reaches US cinemas
events.fact: Pixar's original superhero-family film is released, before its sequel.

events.title: Roger Federer wins Wimbledon for the first time
events.fact: Federer wins his first Grand Slam singles title at Wimbledon.

events.title: Cathy Freeman wins Olympic gold in the 400 metres in Sydney
events.fact: Freeman wins the women's 400 metres in front of her home crowd.

events.title: The US version of The Office first airs
events.fact: NBC's adaptation begins with Steve Carell as Michael Scott; the British original began earlier.

events.title: Rafael Nadal wins the French Open for the first time
events.fact: Nadal wins the men's singles title on his French Open debut.

events.title: The Taj Mahal complex is completed
events.fact: The mausoleum was substantially complete by 1648; work on the surrounding complex continued until about 1653. Both completion conventions are accepted.

events.title: Microsoft's Xbox 360 first goes on sale
events.fact: The console begins its launch in North America in November.

events.title: Serena Williams wins her first Grand Slam singles title
events.fact: Williams wins the US Open women's singles title.

events.title: Sesame Street first airs on US television
events.fact: The children's programme begins its original television run.

events.title: Disney's animated Aladdin reaches US cinemas
events.fact: The original animated film features Aladdin, Jasmine and the Genie; the live-action remake comes much later.

events.title: The first Apple Watch goes on sale
events.fact: Apple's original smartwatch reaches customers after its announcement the previous year.

events.title: Muhammad Ali wins his first world heavyweight title
events.fact: Still known as Cassius Clay at the time, he defeats Sonny Liston in Miami Beach.

events.title: Tiger Woods wins the Masters for the first time
events.fact: Woods wins his first Masters Tournament at Augusta National.

events.title: The online marketplace now called eBay launches
events.fact: The site begins as AuctionWeb before taking the eBay name.

events.title: Netflix begins offering streaming video
events.fact: Netflix adds online streaming to its existing DVD-rental business.

events.title: The first paying space tourist travels to space
events.fact: Dennis Tito flies to the International Space Station as a self-funded space tourist.

events.title: San Francisco's Golden Gate Bridge opens
events.fact: The bridge opens to pedestrians in May, followed by road traffic the next day.

events.title: Michael Jordan wins his first NBA championship
events.fact: Jordan wins his first NBA title with the Chicago Bulls.

events.title: Taylor Swift releases her debut album
events.fact: Her first studio album is self-titled and includes Tim McGraw.

events.title: Instagram launches
events.fact: The photo-sharing app first appears on the iPhone.

events.title: Doctor Who first airs on British television
events.fact: The original television series begins on the BBC.

events.title: The first Super Bowl is played
events.fact: The Green Bay Packers beat the Kansas City Chiefs in the first AFL–NFL championship game, now called Super Bowl I.

events.title: Despacito is released
events.fact: Luis Fonsi and Daddy Yankee release the original song before the later Justin Bieber remix.

events.title: Twitter first launches
events.fact: The service begins under the Twitter name, years before its rebranding as X.

events.title: Post-it Notes go on sale across the US
events.fact: 3M launches Post-it Notes nationally after earlier regional trials.

events.title: The first Android phone goes on sale
events.fact: The HTC Dream, sold as the T-Mobile G1 in the US, reaches customers.

events.title: The original Nintendo Switch goes on sale
events.fact: Nintendo launches its hybrid handheld-and-home console in March.

events.title: A patient receives the first permanent artificial heart
events.fact: Barney Clark receives a Jarvik-7 intended for permanent use, rather than as a temporary bridge to a transplant.

events.title: Beyoncé releases her debut solo album
events.fact: Dangerously in Love is released after her work with Destiny's Child.

events.title: A major fire damages Notre-Dame Cathedral in Paris
events.fact: The fire destroys the cathedral's spire and much of its roof.

events.title: Disney's animated Beauty and the Beast reaches US cinemas
events.fact: The animated film tells Belle and the Beast's story; this is not the later live-action version.

events.title: Pixar's Coco reaches US cinemas
events.fact: Miguel travels to the Land of the Dead in Pixar's animated musical.

events.title: The original Home Alone reaches cinemas
events.fact: Macaulay Culkin plays Kevin in the first Home Alone film.

events.title: TikTok launches outside mainland China
events.fact: This is the international TikTok launch; its Chinese counterpart Douyin began earlier.

events.title: Christopher Nolan's Oppenheimer reaches cinemas
events.fact: Cillian Murphy stars in the film about J. Robert Oppenheimer.

events.title: The first commercial microwave oven goes on sale
events.fact: Raytheon's large Radarange oven reaches commercial customers, well before compact household models.

events.title: Nintendo Switch 2 goes on sale
events.fact: Nintendo's second Switch console launches on 5 June; the original Switch arrived much earlier.

events.title: Michael Phelps wins eight gold medals at one Olympics
events.fact: Phelps wins all eight of his swimming events at the Beijing Games.

events.title: The first Wimbledon tennis championships are held
events.fact: The inaugural tournament takes place in London with a men's singles competition.

events.title: Queen Elizabeth II dies
events.fact: Britain's longest-reigning monarch dies at Balmoral, ending a reign of more than seventy years.

events.title: Brazil wins the men's football World Cup for the first time
events.fact: Brazil wins the tournament in Sweden with a team including Pelé.

events.title: The live-action Barbie film reaches cinemas
events.fact: Margot Robbie stars as Barbie and Ryan Gosling as Ken.

events.title: The atomic bomb is dropped on Hiroshima
events.fact: Hiroshima is bombed in August, three days before the bombing of Nagasaki.

events.title: The McDonald brothers open their first McDonald's restaurant
events.fact: Richard and Maurice McDonald open their San Bernardino restaurant, before Ray Kroc's later franchise business.

events.title: Red Bull launches in Austria
events.fact: The Red Bull drink launches in Austria, following the earlier Thai drink that inspired it.

events.title: Peppa Pig first airs on British television
events.fact: The animated series begins on Channel 5.

events.title: Zoom launches its video-meeting service
events.fact: The first public version of Zoom's video-conferencing service becomes available.

events.title: Sony's PlayStation 5 first goes on sale
events.fact: The console begins its international launch in November.

events.title: Microsoft releases Windows XP
events.fact: The operating system reaches general retail availability in October.

events.title: Monsters, Inc. reaches US cinemas
events.fact: Pixar's film introduces Sulley, Mike and Boo.

events.title: An Olympic gymnast scores the first perfect 10
events.fact: Nadia Comăneci receives the score at the Montreal Summer Olympics.

events.title: Bluey first airs on Australian television
events.fact: The animated series about the Heeler family premieres on ABC Kids.

events.title: The card game Uno first goes on sale
events.fact: Merle Robbins develops and begins selling the colour-and-number card game.

events.title: The original Inside Out reaches US cinemas
events.fact: Pixar's film follows Riley's emotions; this is the first film, not its sequel.

events.title: Squid Game first appears on Netflix
events.fact: The original South Korean series launches internationally on Netflix.

events.title: Disney's animated The Little Mermaid reaches US cinemas
events.fact: Ariel appears in Disney's original animated feature; the live-action remake comes much later.

events.title: Pixar's Up reaches US cinemas
events.fact: Carl and Russell take to the sky in a house carried by balloons.
